title: Chunk instrumentation and trace-handoff with inline redaction for streaming API
creator: Priya Patel
description: Implement lightweight per-emitted-chunk instrumentation that records wall-clock boundaries, emitted token counts, QoS markers, and a trace-handoff token for downstream continuation. Add redact-as-you-stream hooks so raw tokens are never written to searchable logs or metrics while preserving compatibility with older SDK clients via a fallback envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Emit a metric event per emitted chunk containing iso8601 start/end, duration_ms, emitted_token_count, and qos_level tag
Create deterministic per-stream trace spans and expose X-RW-Trace-Handoff header containing opaque handoff token and non-sensitive route tags
Redaction pipeline executes before any log or metric tagging and returns a safe summary and a deterministic redact-mask for correlation
SDK compatibility: new behavior is opt-in via header and auto-enabled for SDKs >= 3.4; older clients receive aggregated-only metrics
Dashboards show per-stream p50/p95 latency, per-chunk emission rate, and backpressure indicators under runtime-1.22
Unit and integration tests cover redaction, handoff, and metric emission with >= 90% coverage for new code paths
implementation_notes: Introduce a pooled chunk_instrument object attached to stream context to avoid per-token allocations
Use ISO8601 timestamps for boundaries and compute duration_ms for histogram buckets
Design X-RW-Trace-Handoff header with minimal opaque token and routing tags; downstream call /trace/continue with token
Redaction returns (safe_summary, redact_mask) where redact_mask is durable and non-reversible for correlation
Compatibility: clients without header get a synthetic low-card stream id and aggregated metrics only
Add runtime env flag STREAM_REDACT_INLINE for canary and emergency rollback

rollout_plan: Canary: enable redact-as-you-stream and trace handoff for 1% hosted traffic with alarms

notes: Trade-off: token-level timings improve debugging but raise metric cardinality; mitigate by using histograms and low-card QoS buckets
Security requested only counts and rates be exported, sample text must be masked
This work can feed Optimizer rules by emitting backpressure signals to suggest batch size adjustments
